_comment: Copy this directory to distros/<your-distro-id>/ and fill in the fields below. The id must match the folder name.
description: One paragraph describing the distro. Who it's for, what makes it distinct. Two to four sentences. Shown in Igloo's distro picker.
defaultDesktopEnvironment: REPLACE: KDE Plasma | GNOME | Cinnamon | XFCE | MATE | LXQt | Budgie | ...
installerType: REPLACE: Anaconda | Ubiquity | Calamares | AutoYaST | Subiquity | Custom
tags: Choose 2-5 tags from: best-for-new-users | best-for-windows-switchers | gaming | development | older-hardware | privacy | security | rolling-release | stable-release | minimal | beginner-friendly | current-kernel | secure-boot-supported | wayland-default | free-software-only-by-default

maintainer.note: Anything Igloo users should know about how this distro is maintained in Igloo's catalog.
